create_feedback: create feedback by inserting a new feedback record with user id, type, data, meta, and snapshot into the database
get_feedback_by_id: get a single feedback record from the database by its unique id
get_feedback_items: get paginated feedback items with optional filters, ordering by username, model_id, rating, or updated_at
get_model_evaluation_history: get daily won and lost counts for a specific model over the past N days from feedback data
update_feedback_by_id: update an existing feedback record by id with new data, meta, and snapshot fields
